composer.agent.label: Plan
composer.hermes.label: Hermes
composer.hermes.desc: Control PC tasks safely through Lexa.
composer.clone.label: Clone UI
composer.clone.prefix: /agent Clone or recreate this UI from the supplied screenshot. Preserve layout intent, accessibility, responsive behavior, and Lexa's product style:
composer.figma.label: Import Figma
composer.figma.prefix: /agent Import or translate this Figma design into Lexa-ready UI. Keep components accessible, responsive, and consistent with the existing codebase:
composer.page.label: Create Page
composer.page.prefix: /agent Create a production-ready page or screen for Lexa. Include layout, states, accessibility, responsive behavior, and tests where useful:
composer.research.label: Research
composer.research.prefix: /agent Create a source-backed research brief: start with a short research plan, use web/file/OS context only when relevant, include a source list, mark unchecked claims clearly, and separate facts, assumptions, evidence, risks, and next actions:
composer.workspace.label: Write
composer.workspace.prefix: /agent Build a reusable workspace draft in Markdown with goal, context, working draft, facts, assumptions, ideas, decisions, evidence, open questions, and next actions. Keep it ready for Personal OS draft review, not stable memory writes:
composer.context.label: Context
composer.context.prefix: /agent Build a compact Personal OS context pack for this task before answering. Use read-only OS tools when useful, cite relevant file paths, separate facts, assumptions, ideas, decisions, evidence, and tasks, and propose draft updates instead of stable-memory writes:
composer.review.label: Review
composer.review.prefix: /agent Review Personal OS pending drafts before any apply. Use read-only draft/review tools, separate facts, assumptions, decisions, evidence, risks, and tasks, recommend approve/reject/defer, and ask for explicit human approval before stable-memory changes:
composer.skill.label: Skills
composer.skill.prefix: /agent Design a reusable Lexa Skill as a Markdown draft. Include purpose, trigger phrases, scope, instructions, inputs, outputs, allowed context/tools, safety boundaries, examples, test checklist, and Personal OS draft handoff. Do not write stable memory without review:
composer.think.label: Think
composer.think.prefix: /agent Create a Deep Think decision brief. Frame the decision, separate facts, assumptions, options, tradeoffs, evidence, risks, reversibility, recommendation, confidence, open questions, and next actions. Use OS/web context only when relevant and provide a concise reasoning summary, not hidden chain-of-thought:
composer.ship.label: Release
composer.ship.prefix: /agent Run a production Ship Check for Lexa. Inspect release readiness, user-facing UX, accessibility, performance, reliability, privacy/security, data-loss risk, docs/onboarding, tests, migration/rollback, launch blockers, and next actions. Separate facts, assumptions, evidence, risks, must-fix before publish, nice-to-have, and verification commands. Do not ship, commit, publish, or write stable OS memory without explicit approval:
composer.improve.label: Improve
composer.improve.prefix: /agent Improve Lexa UI/UX with small safe code changes and run appropriate tests:
composer.os.label: Personal
composer.os.prefix: Use the Personal OS as context and summarize:
composer.screen.label: Screen
composer.screen.prefix: Analyze the screen and give concrete UI/UX improvements:
composer.voice.label: Voice
composer.voice.prefix: Check Voice/STT/TTS/Wake Word status and name the next real blockers:

help.title: **Lexa AI — Help**
help.chatSection: **Chat:** Type a message and press Enter (or Ctrl+Enter if configured). Lexa understands natural language.
help.commandsSection: **Commands:** 138+ PC commands — open apps, organize files, control browser, play music, read emails, Git/Docker, network tools and more.
help.voiceSection: **Voice:** Click the Voice Orb (Ctrl+M) to speak. Lexa listens and responds by voice.
help.shortcutsSection:
**Keyboard Shortcuts:**
• Ctrl+1-9: Switch views
• Ctrl+P: Command Palette
• Ctrl+F: Global search
• Ctrl+N: New chat
• Ctrl+T: Quick todo
• Ctrl+Shift+N: Quick note
• Ctrl+M: Microphone
• Ctrl+L: Clear chat
• Ctrl+B: Sidebar toggle
• Ctrl+/: Shortcut help
• ↑/↓: Input history
• / + Name: Insert snippet
• Esc: Back to chat
help.dragDropSection: **Drag & Drop:** Drag files into the chat for AI analysis (Text, Code, Images, PDF).
help.settingsSection: **Settings:** AI model, Theme, Accent color, Font size, Send mode, Autostart.
